purpose: Define explicit freshness objectives over exact datasets/resources using declared source-time/watermark anchors and thresholds rather than local observation time or guessed age.

topics.name: DWH Freshness Objective
topics.purpose: Define explicit freshness objectives over exact datasets/resources using declared source-time/watermark anchors and thresholds rather than local observation time or guessed age.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant freshness objective has an explicit canonical identity.
semantics.anchor_rule: Freshness anchor is explicit: source event time, accepted revision time, sync watermark, snapshot time or other declared source clock/profile.
semantics.threshold_rule: Target freshness threshold and evaluation window are explicit.
semantics.lag_rule: Observed lag is derived evidence from exact source position/time and current evaluation instant.
semantics.replica_rule: Replica freshness uses authoritative-source watermark/revision provenance where applicable.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown source time/watermark yields unknown freshness, never fresh by default.
semantics.authority_rule: Freshness status grants no read/write authority.

invariants.rule: Freshness, availability, completeness, latency and SLO results are derived service-health evidence over exact data/runtime scopes; they never change data identity, ownership, classification, authorization or execution authority.

hard_gates.condition: freshness computed from local file mtime
replica age measured without authoritative watermark

references.purpose: Replica freshness can use exact sync position.
Streaming freshness can use exact subscription cursor.
